locator: I q.3 a.1 co., second proof: simpliciter tamen actus prior est potentia
interpretation: Priority simply, as opposed to priority in time within one changing thing: anything in potency in a respect presupposes some being in act in that respect, because potency is reduced to act only by a being in act. PriorSimply is a dependence relation distinct from present moving; the reading does not make every potency a present being-moved, and it does not itself say that the prior being is another being.
